author: MANic
text_post: I'm looking to publish in the area of constitutional law and I'm amazed at how every journal pushes essentially identical leftist ideology. Almost all academics (in law) at prestigious institutions are just different shades of liberal - evident from their publication lists, with the most awarded and celebrated academics being the staunchest liberal ideologues. It seems as if legal intellectual disagreement is confined to narrow crevices of leftist thought. Journals indicate a strong trend of 'rightsification' and entitlement (every developmental tool is now a right). Depravity guised as liberty. All the ills highlighted and discussed here.  Even if I do author a great counter-argument which gets published  it will likely destroy any hopes of an academic career or future funding. To compound the issue, tenure is a myth in 2017 so it's not as if restraint gets rewarded with a platform ultimately. The system truly is against us!
